No rotors, rotor blades, propellers, guns, missiles, hooks, probes, antennas, people, cargo, dust, dirt, damage, text, letters, numbers, logos, flags, roundels, dials, screens or lamps. No floor, ground, runway, shadow outside the aircraft, perspective, tilt or visible side faces. Top surfaces only.
